qualitative.gate_2_reason: Addictive, socially destructive tobacco business model facing structural combustible volume declines, aggressive excise taxation, and legislative phase-out/ruin risk.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Rejected – G2 Essential Need). Combustible tobacco manufacturer explicitly disqualified under Gate 2 due to addictive, socially destructive products subject to existential regulatory, legislative, and societal phase-out risks across core European and US markets.
qualitative.evidence: Focused combustible tobacco player (Davidoff, Gauloises, JPS, Winston) with limited next-generation product hedge compared to peers. Structural secular volume contraction in Western markets (typically -5% to -8% annually) cannot be perpetually mitigated by price increases without customer elasticity breaking, compounded by generational smoking bans and punitive excise duties.
